inference_code_hash_format: UTF-8 source with LF line endings

method.evaluation: Primary: margin MAE. Also track margin RMSE, total MAE, per-team score MAE and winner accuracy. No calibrated win probabilities or automatic promotion.
method.fit_recovery: The exact July public fit was reconstructed and reproduced every saved field for all 32 teams. This active-roster / expected-starter inference policy is a separate, unvalidated candidate.
method.history: Team and QB performance through the 2025 regular season. The historical fit and selected parameters are fixed. The embedded results-rating offseason convention is preserved.
method.injury_coverage: ACT is administrative status, not proof of health or game-day availability. No comprehensive practice, injury, or game-day inactive adjustment is included.
method.name: Active-roster preseason scenario
method.roster_policy: Only ACT roster entries; the latest verified active QB1 is selected by depth order. The same roster and QB assumptions apply to every week.
method.schedule: Week 1 was independently checked against NFL.com. Later kickoffs are provider-listed and may change; Week 18 times are provisional.
method.totals: Total = (home 2025 points for/game + home points allowed/game + away points for/game + away points allowed/game) / 2. Expected scores = (total ± home margin) / 2. Whole scores are presentation rounding.
